title: carex squarrosa var. typhinoides

This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, which include its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may provide antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
